notes.title: Official Reveal of DEPRISION Coming in 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41452855/dce7a3e5ee161ead074ff5e7ed0c658a5b4918e3.png[/img]

[b]Dear Community Members and Media Representatives,[/b]

We are excited to announce a significant transformation across our social media channels and digital platforms. Starting October 1st, we will begin production on a major update for [b]DEPRISION[/b]. This marks the beginning of a renewal phase that will impact our social media, website, Steam, Epic Games Store, and other communication channels.

It is important to note that while we are starting production on this update on October 1st, the final update will not be available immediately. During this period, you will see visible changes across our networks and platforms. The update will be unveiled in the best possible way in early to mid-2025, either through a reveal event or in our Part II presentation. The release date for [b]DEPRISION[/b] will be revealed in 2025 during this presentation. While we cannot specify the exact release date at this time, we assure you that the presentation will be ambitious and meticulously organized, featuring the best platforms and a highly polished execution.

Our goal is to provide a smooth and structured transition. Be sure to follow us on our social media channels so you don't miss any details of the exciting developments we are preparing. Visit [url=https://deprisiongame.com/][b]deprisiongame.com[/b][/url] to stay updated on the latest news and updates.

We are eager to share the progress and advancements of [b]DEPRISION[/b] with you. We appreciate your continued support and encourage you to stay tuned for upcoming announcements that promise to be truly exciting.

Sincerely,
[b]AleProgramadorStudios Executive Team[/b]

notes.title: DEPRISION Introduces Advanced Map Loading Technology Inspired by Silent Hill
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41452855/7ed76d2dbdf84d600216d26351b9d62c3d267117.png[/img]


DEPRISION unveils a groundbreaking technological enhancement in its map loading system, drawing inspiration from Silent Hill and refined to deliver an exceptional gaming experience.

Our upgraded technology utilizes fog in different sections of the open world, envisioning seamless distant rendering through SubLevels. Simultaneously, it ensures a 100% level of detail per square meter (M2), significantly enhancing performance and drawing distance. As you move away, you won't perceive the drawing distance, thanks to the optimized level of detail that guarantees high quality across all areas of the game.

Inspired by Silent Hill's professional map loading simulation layer, we have applied and perfected this technology in SubLevels for DEPRISION's open-world environment. Instead of automatically loading sublevels or maps, the entire map will now load, dynamically adjusting detailed systems as you progress. Unlike Silent Hill, which loaded map fragments per second, DEPRISION loads everything at once, allowing only the area where you are located to be extremely detailed. As you advance, the other unused areas will not show a difference in drawing distance, enhancing overall optimization and performance.

Our optimization system anticipates potential issues, such as GPU oversaturation in VRAM and high temperatures in PCs. The sublevels have been specifically designed to integrate with an advanced drawing distance system, further enhancing optimization and overall game performance.

These technological innovations underscore our ongoing commitment to quality and innovation in the gaming industry. DEPRISION strives to provide players with an exceptional experience, and these improvements reflect our dedicated focus on excellence and player satisfaction.

[b]AleProgramadorStudios SRL Team.[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41452855/4f5256e45328c2a993b51564f82cce2561b62647.jpg[/img]

Dear users,

We are pleased to announce that the official release date of our video game DEPRISION will be in the fiscal year 2027. We know this date is far away, but we want to ensure that we deliver a high-quality product that meets our players' expectations.

In the meantime, we will be sending regular updates on the project's progress leading up to the launch. We want you to be involved in the development process and be able to see firsthand how we are advancing in the creation of DEPRISION.

We appreciate your patience and support during this exciting journey towards the official release of DEPRISION.

Sincerely,
The DEPRISION development team
